text: macOS icns generation: scripts/gen-icons.sh's icns block was gated purely on `command -v iconutil`, which only exists on macOS — running the script on any Linux dev box or Linux CI runner silently no-ops that block with zero error output, leaving packaging/macos/icon.icns simply absent. Trap: a script that 'looks done' (exits 0, no error) can still have silently skipped its real work when it soft-gates on a platform-only tool. Fix applied: added a Linux-capable fallback (rsvg-convert + a small python3 ICNS-container assembler) alongside the iconutil path, so the script produces a real icon.icns on Linux too. Watch for the same pattern with any other mac-only CLI (plutil, codesign, notarytool, stapler) silently no-op'ing in this Linux-first dev/CI environment for the rest of M3/M4.
